dogecoin.text: 2- Second, the influence of famous personalities, such as Elon Musk, plays a significant role. His tweets containing mentions of Dogecoin often cause sharp fluctuations in the rate, attracting the attention of millions of users and stimulating speculative capital flows.

. At first glance, Dogecoin, Shiba Inu, Pepe Coin, and other similar projects are just digital jokes generated by internet culture. However, funny images and names hide a complex economic reality that affects capital allocation and market liquidity.
